0.Name: Mutabor
0.Text: A liner series with an additional system of artifact connection and afterburner capacity.

1.Name: Heavy Gavon
1.Text: A maloq transport vessel, refitted for espionage and recon.

10.Name: Indigo
10.Text: A hull for safe transport of passengers. Has a defensive field and auxiliary armaments.

11.Name: Myriada
11.Text: A government-commissioned hull series intended for maloq and peleng diplomatic missions.

12.Name: Economist
12.Text: A small and economical hull. A fine solution for those on a budget and with sensible ergonomic expectations.

125.Name: Tadai
125.Text: A standard maloq hull with a gripper.

126.Name: Snatcher
126.Text: A standard peleng hull with a gripper.

127.Name: Trek
127.Text: A standard human hull with a gripper slot.

128.Name: Lantaka
128.Text: A standard faeyan hull with a gripper.

129.Name: Olapu
129.Text: A standard gaalian hull with a gripper.

13.Name: Experimeter
13.Text: An unfinished joint project of peleng and human scientists. Shield generator, radar and scanner cannot be installed.

130.Name: Visor
130.Text: A standard hull with a radar and scanner.

14.Name: Large Shuttle
14.Text: A ship designed to transport large-size cargoes. No gripper can be installed.

15.Name: Bagamote
15.Text: A big hull for big business. Manufactured by humans and pelengs.

16.Name: Mirtha
16.Text: A ship designed in keeping with all the canons of the pacifist ideology. A budget model.

17.Name: Tortillo
17.Text: A spacious hull for secure transport of seized cargoes and detainees.

18.Name: Global Union
18.Text: A large hull for secure transport. An impeccable choice.

19.Name: Arriva
19.Text: A hull for noble causes. The fae labored to create the most comfortable living quarters around.

2.Name: El Dorado
2.Text: A luxurious hull with an inner trim of pakryak leather and gold. Complete hardware package.

20.Name: Zahadoom
20.Text: An ultra-speed series with complete defense, arms and navigation. Designed for peleng special forces.

21.Name: Fatso Crue
21.Text: A series of modernized vessels from old man Crue, known for his love of comfort and irrational fear of droids.

22.Name: Phoenix Crue
22.Text: A minor modification of light faeyan transport vessels toward increased combat readiness, compliments of old man Crue.

23.Name: Courier
23.Text: A series of miniature hulls, designed for fast shipment of valuable cargoes and information.

3.Name: Holy Brahmin
3.Text: An inexpensive hull for religious and charitable purposes.

30.Name: Legion of Doom
30.Text: A powerful combat hull. The choice of real men.

31.Name: Nighthawk
31.Text: A reliable interceptor ship. The hull of choice for peleng and faeyan pirates.

32.Name: Black Widow
32.Text: A mobile combat ship. The choice of ruthless killers.

33.Name: Ubishack
33.Text: A series of hulls stolen and modernized by pelengs. The droid compartment has been refitted to a weapons bay.

34.Name: Punishing Ray
34.Text: A fully-functional combat ship in a lower price tier. Does not come with slots for artifacts.

35.Name: Stinging Arrow
35.Text: A light combat ship for quick reacting. Indispensable for pirate hunting.

36.Name: Divine Retribution
36.Text: A formidable series of hulls for lightning-fast attacks. Never goes out of fashion.

37.Name: Neopatrol
37.Text: A hull with human and faeyan police markings. Designed for customs cargo collection.

38.Name: Blind Fury
38.Text: The perfect killing machine. No radar or scanner can be installed.

39.Name: Chegantine
39.Text: A peleng parade combat cruiser with a gym and a mud pool on the second deck. Designed and manufactured for the Supreme Lyakusha.

4.Name: Extreme Light
4.Text: A low-budget series for extreme jumps at high speeds. Maximum speed with minimum defense

40.Name: Microbus
40.Text: All redundant and seldom used modules have been removed from this hull.

41.Name: Technorock
41.Text: This series of advanced tech hulls includes a complete set of machinery installation mounts. The peak of hull technology innovation.

42.Name: Bravado
42.Text: A small hull for brave fighters. Does not come with a slot for scanner. Afterburner mode not supported.

43.Name: Gendarme
43.Text: Bane of pirates. Looks so scary that the engineers didn't even bother installing a protection generator.

44.Name: Antidominator
44.Text: A pricey and effective weapon against dominators. The choice of true patriots.

45.Name: Barbarian
45.Text: A series of spacious hulls for lone warriors who aren't keen on speed. Comes with a gripper slot.

46.Name: Supernova
46.Text: Elite faeyan hulls for top military officials. The interior reflects the latest innovations in technology and design.

47.Name: Red Hatchet
47.Text: A spacious combat ship padded with red plastic on the inside. No scanner can be installed.

48.Name: Enhancer
48.Text: A series of inexpensive hulls, designed for research troops. Weak weaponry, comes with a gripper.

49.Name: Sweeper
49.Text: An aggressive hull, atypical of gaals, with high functionality for trash collection and recycling.

5.Name: Full Extreme
5.Text: A large gaalian hull without any defensive equipment and limited offensive options. For extreme survival in space.

50.Name: Jabus
50.Text: A powerful hull that leaves the enemy no chance. Spacious enough to fit a mud pool.

51.Name: Kamikaze
51.Text: This antique was manufactured from blueprints recovered during excavations on planet Earth.

52.Name: Cerberus
52.Text: A maneuverable patrol ship, designed for protecting systems.

6.Name: Business Class
6.Text: A comfortable hull of increased reliability.

60.Name: Jolly Roger
60.Text: The classic choice of a reckless pirate. Naturally, no shield generator can be installed.

61.Name: Scatterbrain
61.Text: A light ship, designed for collecting artifact trophies. No shield generator or droid envisaged.

62.Name: Fervex-Lyakusha
62.Text: A hull for middle-class fun-loving lyakushas.

63.Name: Cuttlefish
63.Text: A legendary pirate series capable of supporting all weapon types.

64.Name: Rotten Tooth
64.Text: A spacious hull for lower-class pirates. No afterburner or shield generator envisaged.

65.Name: Universe's Chump
65.Text: A cheap hull, popular with the dregs of society.

66.Name: Arrival Tolosum
66.Text: A famous maloq series named after Arriva Tolosum, warrior and explorer.

67.Name: Small Crank
67.Text: A workhorse of fences and pirates. No shield generator envisaged.

68.Name: Vengeance
68.Text: A well-protected hull for vengeful types. The absence of a droid is the only notable drawback.

69.Name: Black Skull
69.Text: A hull ornamented with black skulls. Strikes fear into the hearts of mortals, including other pirates. No scanner can be installed.

7.Name: Orlando
7.Text: A hull for aggressive diplomats. No gripper can be installed.

70.Name: Terror Bone
70.Text: A hull for a seasoned pirate, making even maloq warriors tremble in fear.

71.Name: Splinter
71.Text: Upon release, this series of hulls added a weapon slot to the base configuration, spelling even more trouble for merchants.

72.Name: Locust
72.Text: A ship for an aspiring pirate. No scanner or shield generator can be installed.

73.Name: Chvakha's Puddle
73.Text: A hull belonging to the Chvakha pirate order. Contains a large mud pool for relaxing and washing off blood after a battle.

74.Name: Tratakhan
74.Text: A maloq hull for lawless pirate tomfoolery. Comes with a droid.

75.Name: Ravenous Penchecrakus
75.Text: The ship's beastly power all but guarantees victory over any opponent. The dream of any peleng.

76.Name: Xwiru
76.Text: A tiny faeyan hull, comprised of state-of-the-art microsystems. Perfect for scouting and spying.

77.Name: New Xwiru
77.Text: A modified faeyan hull of the Xwiru series. The size has been increased.

78.Name: Catosaurus
78.Text: A combat hull. The interior trim's prehistoric theme excellently complements its increased firepower.

79.Name: Predator
79.Text: A combat hull of maloq egghead hunters.

8.Name: Grace
8.Text: A small hull sufficient for effective discharging of diplomatic duties. Designed to carry modern mid-size tech.

80.Name: Phantom
80.Text: An inconspicuous hull used to transport classified documents.

9.Name: Omaha
9.Text: A light gaalian hull, designed for those with the need for speed and high maneuverability.

90.Name: Star Wanderer
90.Text: A famous series of human ranger hulls, , it is also used by pirates as disguise. No personal scanner envisaged.

91.Name: Sands of Time
91.Text: A low-budget line of ships for destitute rangers.

92.Name: Stainless Steel Brat
92.Text: A high-speed hull for peleng rangers who favor tactical retreat over inglorious death.

93.Name: Weaponsmith
93.Text: The cabin's trim features decorative elements of weapons and ammo -- a boon for those who like to show off their power.

94.Name: Mongoose
94.Text: An ideal hull for frequent flyers. Commissioned by the network of ranger centers.

95.Name: Farcry
95.Text: A spacious ranger hull, ideal for unhurried transport of fragile and dangerous cargoes. Only for courageous faeyans.

96.Name: Sentinel
96.Text: A hard gaalian nut. A ranger hull with a spacious cargo bay and powerful weapons bay. No scanner can be installed.

97.Name: Lone Traveler
97.Text: A human hull for leisurely ranger travels. The living quarters is decorated with paintings depicting landscapes of the ancient planet Earth.

98.Name: Googol
98.Text: A fast ranger hull. Voted the best hull of 3299.

99.Name: Ideal
99.Text: The ideal ranger hull for any operation. Exclusively commissioned by the network of ranger centers.

HullOldfag.Name: Tauhit
HullOldfag.Text: Old hull series, whose roots dated sometime around end of the Klissan War. Initially created as a top-secret project for ranger's special operation forces, it's still one of the most closed Coalition development ever made.
